title: Repository search absence is not exhaustive provenance absence
durable_memory: A zero-result repository code-search response cannot classify M-004, M-005, or M-006 as unlocated. Unlocated status requires evidence that all relevant branches, reachable commits, decision logs, language lexicons, project documents, and retained continuity artifacts were traversed under a documented coverage method.

claims.claim: Repository-scoped searches for the combined identifiers, M-004 provenance language, CM-1013, the queue objective text, and decision-log or lexicon terminology returned no indexed matches during this run.
claims.source: GitHub connector repository search responses for MirrorCartographer/mirror-cartographer-ui

claims.claim: The canonical queue still requires exhaustive branch inventory or equivalent history traversal before any unlocated classification.

Indexed code search may omit unindexed refs, unreachable history, renamed files, deleted paths retained only in history, or content outside its search surface; therefore a zero-result response proves only no match within the returned search coverage.

Require a coverage receipt before changing any M-004, M-005, or M-006 node from unresolved to unlocated. The receipt must identify enumerated refs, traversal method, commit/object coverage, searched namespaces, time, tool identity, and known exclusions.
claims.acceptance_test: A reviewer can reproduce the traversal and determine whether every relevant reachable object and named source class was covered.

claims.claim: No repository search result means the historical artifact never existed.
The immutable origins and locations of M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved because exhaustive ref and history coverage was not available in this run.

specialist_registry.reason: The durable capability gap concerns evidence coverage, not a missing specialist role; the registry rule was not satisfied for an addition or retirement.

falsification_route: Produce an authenticated exhaustive branch and reachable-object traversal that locates an immutable source object assigning M-004, M-005, or M-006, or demonstrates documented exhaustive coverage with no such object.
next_action: Create and execute a reproducible refs-and-history coverage receipt, then reconcile each identifier against immutable objects without recreating missing history.
